description: Source code for the quic_memory_cache_backend.cc implementing an in-memory cache backend for QUIC protocol, including response management, resource file parsing, and server push handling.

classes.name: QuicMemoryCacheBackend::ResourceFile
classes.description: Represents a resource file with methods to read and parse HTTP headers, URL handling, and body content.

methods.name: QuicMemoryCacheBackend::ResourceFile::Read
methods.description: Reads file contents and parses HTTP headers, handling special headers like X-Original-Url and X-Push-Url.

methods.name: QuicMemoryCacheBackend::ResourceFile::SetHostPathFromBase
methods.description: Sets host and path based on a base URL string.

methods.name: QuicMemoryCacheBackend::ResourceFile::RemoveScheme
methods.description: Removes http:// or https:// scheme from a URL string.

methods.name: QuicMemoryCacheBackend::ResourceFile::HandleXOriginalUrl
methods.description: Processes the X-Original-Url header to set host and path.
